name: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad
role: Founder & Medical Director – Shobha Hospital Multi Speciality
bio: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad is the Founder and Clinical Director of Shobha Hospital, a dedicated initiative focused on women’s health, safe motherhood, and integrative reproductive care. With strong academic training from IMS–BHU and advanced surgical expertise, he brings together modern obstetric science and Ayurvedic wisdom to deliver ethical, evidence-based, and patient-centred care.

items: Gynecology and minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery
Management of PCOD, hormonal disorders, and reproductive challenges

sections.title: Surgical & Clinical Approach
paras: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad follows a minimally invasive, safety-first approach, prioritising normal delivery whenever possible and recommending surgical intervention only when medically indicated. His practice is rooted in transparent counselling, informed decision-making, and long-term patient wellbeing.

sections.title: Role at Shobha Hospital
paras: As the clinical head, Dr. Sachin leads all medical services at Shobha Hospital and oversees the integration of Ayurveda with modern gynecology and obstetrics. He manages Shobha Hospital Multi Speciality, Khanvel, ensuring high standards of safety, hygiene, and ethical practice.

items: Integration of Ayurveda and modern medical science
Focus on preventive care and safe motherhood

closing: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad’s mission is deeply aligned with the vision of Creating “श्रेयसी प्रजा” — nurturing healthy women, empowered families, and a balanced society through responsible and integrative healthcare.
roles2: Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist (Ay) | Infertility Specialist | Gynec Endoscopic (Laparoscopic) Surgeon
qualification: MS (PTSR) – IMS, Banaras Hindu University · FMAS – MUHS

name: Dr. Randhir Kadam
bio: Dr. Randhir Kadam is a senior Ayurvedic surgeon with extensive experience in general surgical care. He serves as the backbone of surgical infrastructure at Shree Seva Hospital, Talasari, providing safe, ethical, and patient-focused surgical services to the community. His clinical expertise, combined with a disciplined surgical approach, ensures reliable outcomes and high standards of care.

items: General Surgeon at Shobha Hospital, Khanvel
Director – Shree Seva Hospital, Talasari, Palghar, Maharashtra

sections.title: Surgical Approach
paras: Dr. Kadam follows evidence-based surgical protocols with a strong emphasis on patient safety, hygiene, and ethical decision-making. He believes in choosing surgical intervention only when medically necessary and ensures clear counselling and informed consent for every patient.

sections.title: Role at Shobha Hospital
paras: As a key surgical consultant, Dr. Randhir Kadam provides the clinical and infrastructural support that enables Shobha Hospital to deliver safe gynecological and obstetric surgical services within an established hospital setting.

items: Commitment to community health and wellbeing

closing: Dr. Randhir Kadam’s dedication to surgical excellence and ethical practice strengthens Shobha Hospital’s mission of delivering trusted, integrative healthcare services to the community.
